about: Registered explanations of gate failures (docs/PREREG_observer_advantage_keys.md, section 8). Each pins the numbers it explains; a rerun that changes them is unexplained again.

dispositions.explanation: GPU numerics (Colab A100), not harness drift: fp16 reproduces the record on all three Tier A models, Llama-2 nf4a passes G1 on the GV100, and Mistral's one-ulp jitter alone moves qasper 0.5 points.
